name: som
description: Stage-gated multi-agent runs on the Orca CLI plus the SOM Doc Standard. Ambiguity-gated intake, wave scheduling with write-conflict avoidance, autonomy levels with frozen hard floors, Snowflake access that runs reads and asks before writes, and self-contained local-file deliverables (HTML and xlsx today; docx and pptx are not implemented yet).
_note: hooks and monitors are auto-discovered from hooks/hooks.json and monitors/monitors.json. Declaring them as path strings in this manifest makes the plugin fail to load -- verified by bisection. bkit does not declare them either.
